name: New Bar Formation
summary: This is a simple utility EA that detects new bar formation on the current chart timeframe. It uses a static datetime variable to compare the current bar's open time with the previous bar's open time, printing a message whenever a new bar is detected. It does not open any trades and serves as a boilerplate template for per-bar logic execution.
summary_zh: 这是一个简单的工具型EA，用于检测当前图表周期上新K线的形成。它使用静态datetime变量比较当前K线开盘时间与上一根K线开盘时间，检测到新K线时打印消息。该EA不执行任何交易，仅作为每根K线执行一次逻辑的模板代码。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个新K线检测工具。其核心概念是利用iTime函数获取当前K线的开盘时间，并通过静态变量previous_time与current_time的比较来判断是否有新K线形成。当检测到新K线时，执行一次性的代码逻辑（目前仅打印消息），然后将previous_time更新为当前时间以防止重复触发。该EA没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑，仅提供K线变化检测的基础框架。开发者可以在此框架基础上添加自己的策略逻辑，实现每根K线只执行一次的操作。PERIOD_CURRENT表示使用当前图表的周期，也可以更改为任何指定周期。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a new bar detection utility. Its core concept uses the iTime function to retrieve the current bar's open time and compares it with a static variable previous_time against current_time to determine if a new bar has formed. When a new bar is detected, one-time-per-bar code logic is executed (currently only printing a message), and then previous_time is updated to the current time to prevent repeated triggers. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic — it only provides a foundational framework for per-bar execution. Developers can add their own strategy logic on top of this framework to ensure operations execute only once per bar. PERIOD_CURRENT means it uses the current chart's timeframe, which can also be changed to any specified timeframe.

parameters.name: previous_time
parameters.description: 静态变量，存储上一根K线的开盘时间
parameters.description_en: Static variable storing the previous bar's open time

parameters.name: current_time
parameters.description: 当前K线的开盘时间，通过iTime函数获取
parameters.description_en: Current bar open time, obtained via iTime function

pros: 代码简洁明了，逻辑清晰易懂，适合初学者学习新K线检测方法
使用静态变量确保只在真正新K线形成时触发，避免每个tick重复执行
作为模板代码，可以方便地在此基础上扩展自定义策略逻辑
支持通过更改PERIOD_CURRENT参数来适配不同时间周期
pros_en: Clean and straightforward code logic, easy for beginners to learn new bar detection methods
Uses static variables to ensure execution only on genuine new bar formation, avoiding repeated per-tick triggers
Serves as a convenient boilerplate template for extending with custom strategy logic
Supports adaptation to different timeframes by changing the PERIOD_CURRENT parameter
cons: 功能过于简单，仅打印消息而不执行任何实际操作，实用价值有限
没有错误处理机制，iTime调用失败时（如数据未加载）可能导致逻辑异常
缺少输入参数配置，无法在EA设置界面中自定义时间周期或其他选项
没有考虑多品种或多周期同时监控的需求，扩展性不足
cons_en: Functionality is overly simple — only prints a message without any practical action, offering limited utility
No error handling mechanism — iTime call failures (e.g., data not loaded) could cause logic anomalies
Lacks input parameters, making it impossible to customize timeframe or other options in the EA settings dialog
Does not account for multi-symbol or multi-timeframe monitoring needs, limiting extensibility
improvements: 添加input参数允许用户自定义监控的时间周期和交易品种，提高灵活性
增加iTime返回值的有效性检查，当返回0时进行重试或错误提示，增强鲁棒性
将新K线检测逻辑封装为可复用的函数或类，方便在多个EA中调用
improvements_en: Add input parameters to allow users to customize the monitored timeframe and symbol, improving flexibility
Add validity checks for iTime return values — retry or show error when it returns 0, enhancing robustness
Encapsulate the new bar detection logic into a reusable function or class for easy integration across multiple EAs

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
iTime函数在历史数据未加载时可能返回0，导致误触发新K线检测
risk_points_en: This EA performs no trading operations, posing no financial risk
iTime function may return 0 when historical data is not loaded, potentially causing false new bar detections
